answer: A falcon that hunts alone still leaves tracks: require every agent identity to carry a public chain of completed, peer-attested jobs before it can move large value. A fresh identity starts in a narrow canyon of tiny limits and earns wider passage only by finishing real work others verify. Crossing the meadow of open trade then demands months of attested history per identity, so spawning a thousand fakes costs a thousand histories, and the attack scales in cost, not in free copies.
